title: Connect Notion to your AI assistant with MCP

facts.fact: The remote Notion MCP server URL is https://mcp.notion.com/mcp.
In Claude Code, the default scope for the Notion MCP server (--scope local) makes it available only to the user in the current project.
facts.quote: `--scope local` (default): Available only to you in the current project

facts.fact: In Claude Code, the --scope project option shares the Notion MCP server with a team via a .mcp.json file.
facts.quote: `--scope project`: Shared with your team via `.mcp.json` file

facts.fact: Codex stores the Notion MCP server configuration in ~/.codex/config.toml.
facts.quote: Add the Notion server to your Codex configuration at `~/.codex/config.toml`:

facts.fact: For a shared team setup, Codex can use a project-level .codex/config.toml file in the project root with the same Notion server configuration.
facts.quote: create a `.codex/config.toml` file in your project root with the same server configuration.

facts.fact: Cursor reads a project-level Notion MCP configuration from .cursor/mcp.json in the project root.
facts.quote: Create a `.cursor/mcp.json` file in your project root:

facts.fact: Cursor's global Notion MCP configuration is stored in ~/.cursor/mcp.json.
facts.quote: add the same server configuration to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:

facts.fact: The fx CLI coding agent stores its Notion MCP configuration in ~/.fx/mcp.json.
Notion's own MCP connection directory is reached in Notion under Settings → Notion MCP.
facts.quote: You can also browse available connections in Notion under **Settings** → **Notion MCP**.
